pointwise_cut_interface.rebind_rule: bind a local exact certificate whose primitive graph coverage, strict D3+ inequalities, true-cut rank<=4, and every noncut rank>=5 are all PASS
pointwise_cut_interface.required_claim: For every strict D3+ K3P tensor of a standard strong level-2 network, rank Flat_{A|Ac}<=4 iff A|Ac is a bridge split.

exact_reconstruction.input_model: exact-real oracle supporting field operations, polynomial signs, and real-closed-field quantifier elimination
steps: recover the labelled bridge tree using the pointwise cut criterion
extract normalized three-sector component factors with bridge incidence slices
enumerate the finite rigid-support atlas candidates and apply exact local separators
use coherent one-port and two-port records to recover segment membership and order
assemble coherent mixed graphs and group them into ordinary-triangle classes
decide exact semialgebraic feasibility for each finite class and return the unique feasible class outside E_N
exact_reconstruction.termination: finite topology/ledger enumeration plus terminating real-closed-field quantifier elimination

genericity.exceptional_set: finite union of proper Zariski closures of inequivalent intersections, singular/rank-drop loci, and certified nonzero reconstruction-test zeros
genericity.inequivalent_intersection_dimension: at most d_N-1, else a target analytic section gives forbidden regular full-dimensional containment
genericity.model_closure_irreducible: closure of a polynomial image of irreducible affine parameter space
genericity.rank_drop_image_dimension: at most d_N-1 by finite constant-rank semialgebraic stratification
genericity.scope: for each fixed topology N; not pointwise parameter identifiability

simultaneous_physical_bridge_gluing.incidence_product_compact_bounds: 0<L<=A_h<=U on the finite common compactly-contained local germs
